motivation: Frozen RGB feature pooling on raw/IR foreground is negative even on optimistic Train identity AUC. The November pseudo-IR has not been given a newly trained native pixel encoder in this campaign; an old constructed-IR representation is not a substitute. Test whether explicit new-IR representation adaptation and paired RGB alignment supply useful association evidence.
setting: Actual November DiffV2IR images only, original Protocol V2 and detector sources unchanged. Native scalar IR is replicated to three channels only for the preserved RGB architecture; it is not a physical thermal measurement.
observations: Exactly11967 preserved Train observations,2551 unique frames,98 composite identities in Train6. Never use the legacy ir_file from the historical crop index. All current new-IR paths are recomputed from the frozen November root.
crop_cache: One compact uint8 derived Train crop bank outside Git, not a full-image dataset copy.128x256,5%-margin letterbox; explicit valid rectangle restores zero padding after ImageNet normalization. Original frames and images are never copied. Expected raw RGB+IR pixels<1.6GiB; compressed bank and per-worker CPU tensors under the existing64GiB cap.
architecture: Same ResNet50,2048-to512 projection,BN neck,98-class identity classifier as the preserved Train RGB encoder. One native new-IR branch and one extra native RGB control, same initialization, parameter count, batches, losses, augmentation and budget.
teacher: The preserved frozen RGB identity vectors from the exact Train bank, no gradient into the teacher. Reuse existing features instead of a second teacher forward.
loss: Smoothed CE0.1 + same-video post-neck cosine batch-hard triplet margin0.3, positive time gap>=25 +0.5 paired frozen RGB teacher POST-neck cosine loss.
sampler: 8 distinct Train composite identities per batch,8 observations each from eight lifespan strata; same row draws and augmentation seed for the two matched cue arms.
checkpoint_policy: Atomic resumable latest with optimizer/RNG; compact FP16 candidate weights every6 epochs. The initial native representation control uses fixed executed36-epoch weights, not a checkpoint chosen on Train or Test. Downstream association fitting and any representation repairs still require complete Dev curves and matched controls.
resources: Only physical GPUs2/3, one native encoder fit per card beside at most one existing association fit. Require>=12GiB free, limit encoder memory fraction0.35. All crops/weights/features stay outside Git; total campaign soft cap64GiB and work filesystem reserve40GiB.
preflight: Both allowed GPUs must pass a real Train RGB/new-IR crop/forward check. Source/label arrays must match the preserved Train bank exactly; no Dev/Test row may enter fitting.
required_controls: No paired RGB distillation if a benefit survives
No native cue increment and mismatched native cue features
Final same-backend RGB/double-RGB controls, all three seeds and all7 Test videos
interpretation: Representation-conditioning and ordinary supervised distillation repair, not by itself an innovation. Complete same-backend RGB/IR Dev/Test evidence and module removals remain necessary.
reason: Native IR discrimination is much weaker on unseen Dev identities than seen Train identities; raw normalized pre-neck features remain nearly parallel. Apply metric and paired distillation losses in the actual post-BN inference space, identically for RGB and new IR.
initial_policy: Resume weights only from each completed matched36-epoch native model; reset optimizer for the registered36-epoch representation repair. Total encoder adaptation72 epochs per arm, not36.
feature_space: Unit post-neck identity vectors, exactly the inference representation. BN float32 state retained in the final compact checkpoint.
snapshot_policy: One atomic resumable latest per arm plus one compact exact FP32 endpoint at fixed36. No intermediate model snapshot series.
